name: Iranian qanat groundwater conveyance
description: Qanat systems carry groundwater through gravity-fed underground channels for settlements and agriculture, with communal water management.

impact.note: Stands for qanats across the Iranian plateau, which made settlement and farming possible in dry country there, and were copied in neighbouring regions.

date.label: 2016 World Heritage inscription
date.basis: The stated range or year applies to the described evidence or documentary event; it does not establish invention.

events.statement: The serial property comprising eleven Iranian qanats was inscribed on the World Heritage List in 2016.

evidence.locator: Property description and date of inscription
evidence.supports: UNESCO identifies eleven qanats in the property and dates its inscription to 2016.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest sourced event for this particular case, not a claim of global priority.

caveats: The date records inscription of a serial property, not the systems’ invention; the page also describes communal management as continuing, but does not establish a dated survey of every practice in 2016.

research.note: Independent review checked the inscription date, property count and the page’s present-tense management description.

measures.subject: Persian Qanat World Heritage property
measures.conditions: Number of qanats comprising the serial property in 2016; not the total in Iran.

evidence.supports: The serial property comprises eleven qanats.
